blocks.en: Both the data and the solutions for problems in PDEs are functions defined on certain domains or manifolds. In order to formulate precise theorems of existence, uniqueness, continuous dependence, etc., it is essential to specify the spaces in which the functions lie and to give a precise meaning to convergence in those spaces. This issue has led to the development of what is now considered one of the main (``core'') fields of pure mathematics, namely, functional analysis. In this and the subsequent chapter, we shall give a brief introduction to this field, with particular emphasis on those issues and concepts that are important in differential equations. This introduction is limited to what is needed in the rest of the book and is not meant as a substitute for a proper course in functional analysis.
blocks.zh: 偏微分方程问题的数据和解都是定义在某些区域或流形上的函数. 为精确陈述存在性, 唯一性, 连续依赖性等定理, 必须指明这些函数所在的空间, 并精确定义这些空间中的收敛. 这一问题推动了如今被视为纯数学主要 (``核心'') 领域之一的泛函分析的发展. 在本章及下一章中, 将简要介绍这一领域, 特别着重于在微分方程中重要的问题和概念. 本介绍仅限于本书其余部分所需的内容, 并不意在替代一门正规的泛函分析课程.

blocks.en: The fundamental concept used to define a notion of distance between functions is that of a norm.
blocks.zh: 用于定义函数之间距离概念的基本概念是范数.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: def:normed-vector-space-norm

blocks.en: It is easy to see (cf. Problem~\ref{ex:norm-induced-metric}) that the function $d(x,y)=\|x-y\|$ defines a metric on $X$. From this, we also obtain a notion of convergence, i.e., we say that $x_n\to x$ if $\|x_n-x\|\to0$. Terminology familiar from the finite-dimensional case will be adopted in a natural way, e.g., a (closed) ball centered at $x$ with radius $r$ is the set of all $y$ with $\|y-x\|\leq r$, a set $M$ is bounded, if $\{\|x\|\mid x\in M\}$ is bounded etc.
blocks.zh: 容易看出 (参见 Problem~\ref{ex:norm-induced-metric}), 函数 $d(x,y)=\|x-y\|$ 在 $X$ 上定义了一个度量. 由此也得到收敛概念, 即若 $\|x_n-x\|\to0$, 就说 $x_n\to x$. 将自然沿用有限维情形中熟悉的术语, 例如, 以 $x$ 为中心, 半径为 $r$ 的 (闭) 球是所有满足 $\|y-x\|\leq r$ 的 $y$ 的集合; 若 $\{\|x\|\mid x\in M\}$ 有界, 就称集合 $M$ 有界, 等等.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Two normed vector spaces $X$ and $Y$ are called \textbf{isometric}, if there is a linear bijection $L:X\to Y$ such that $\|L(x)\|=\|x\|$ for every $x\in X$.
blocks.zh: 若存在一个线性双射 $L:X\to Y$, 使对每个 $x\in X$ 有 $\|L(x)\|=\|x\|$, 则称两个赋范向量空间 $X$ 和 $Y$ \textbf{等距}.
blocks.label: def:normed-vector-spaces-isometry

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Two norms $\|\cdot\|_1$ and $\|\cdot\|_2$ on a vector space $X$ are called \textbf{equivalent} if there are constants $c,C>0$ such that $c\|x\|_1\leq\|x\|_2\leq C\|x\|_1$ for every $x\in X$.
blocks.zh: 若存在常数 $c,C>0$, 使对每个 $x\in X$ 有 $c\|x\|_1\leq\|x\|_2\leq C\|x\|_1$, 则称向量空间 $X$ 上的两个范数 $\|\cdot\|_1$ 和 $\|\cdot\|_2$ \textbf{等价}.
blocks.label: def:equivalent-norms

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Procedures to solve partial differential equations are usually based on iteration methods, discretization or other means of approximation. In all these cases, one generates a sequence of approximate solutions and one wants to show that this sequence converges to a limit. Since it is usually not a priori clear that a solution to the PDE exists, one needs a convergence criterion that does not involve the limit. This leads to the notion of a Cauchy sequence. It is hence an important issue whether a normed vector space is complete.
blocks.zh: 求解偏微分方程的过程通常基于迭代方法, 离散化或其他逼近手段. 在所有这些情形中, 都会产生一个近似解序列, 并希望证明该序列收敛到某个极限. 由于通常事先并不清楚偏微分方程的解是否存在, 因而需要不涉及极限的收敛判据. 这就引出了 Cauchy 序列的概念. 因此, 赋范向量空间是否完备是一个重要问题.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A normed vector space $X$ is called a \textbf{Banach space} if it is complete, i.e., if every sequence $x_n$ such that $\lim_{m,n\to\infty}\|x_n-x_m\|=0$ has a limit $x\in X$.
blocks.zh: 若赋范向量空间 $X$ 完备, 即每个满足 $\lim_{m,n\to\infty}\|x_n-x_m\|=0$ 的序列 $x_n$ 都有极限 $x\in X$, 则称其为 \textbf{Banach 空间}.
blocks.label: def:banach-space

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If a normed space is not complete, we can define its completion; the procedure for this is the usual one for completing a metric space, i.e., by considering equivalence classes of Cauchy sequences.
blocks.zh: 若赋范空间不完备, 可以定义它的完备化; 其过程是度量空间完备化的通常过程, 即考察 Cauchy 序列的等价类.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $X$ be a normed vector space. Then there exists a normed vector space $Y$ such that $Y$ is complete and $X$ is a dense subspace of $Y$. Up to isometry, the space $Y$ is unique.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 为赋范向量空间. 那么存在赋范向量空间 $Y$, 使 $Y$ 完备且 $X$ 为 $Y$ 的稠密子空间. 在等距意义下, 空间 $Y$ 唯一.
blocks.label: thm:normed-space-completion

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The space $Y$ given by Theorem~\ref{thm:normed-space-completion} is called the \textbf{completion} of $X$.
blocks.zh: Theorem~\ref{thm:normed-space-completion} 给出的空间 $Y$ 称为 $X$ 的\textbf{完备化}.
blocks.label: def:normed-space-completion

blocks.en: One of the greatest difficulties with the proof above is the rather cumbersome notation required. In practice, we dispense with the notation and refer to an element of $Y$ as the \emph{limit} of a Cauchy sequence in $X$; i.e., for any $y\in Y$, we will say that a sequence $\{y_n\}\subset X$ satisfies $y_n\to y$ rather than say that $\{y_n\}$ is a member of the equivalence class $y$. We work with the space $Y$ directly and revive $X$ only when absolutely necessary. Of course, you already do this unconsciously in the case of real numbers: $\sqrt2$ and $\pi$ are thought of as single points on the number line or at worst as decimal expansions rather than as equivalence classes of rational sequences.
blocks.zh: 上述证明的最大困难之一是所需的记号相当繁琐. 实际上, 会省去这些记号, 将 $Y$ 的一个元素称为 $X$ 中某个 Cauchy 序列的\emph{极限}; 即对任意 $y\in Y$, 会说序列 $\{y_n\}\subset X$ 满足 $y_n\to y$, 而不说 $\{y_n\}$ 是等价类 $y$ 的一个成员. 直接使用空间 $Y$, 只在绝对必要时才重新提及 $X$. 当然, 对实数你早已不自觉地这样做了: $\sqrt2$ 和 $\pi$ 被视为数轴上的单个点, 或至多视为小数展开, 而不是有理数序列的等价类.
blocks.label: rem:completion-limit-notation
